title: Covering design C(24,17,7)
statement: Find 17-subsets (blocks) of {1, ..., 24} such that every 7-subset lies in some block, with as few blocks as possible. The best known size in the Covering Repository is 56 blocks (ours); a design with fewer blocks improves it.
submission: Text file: one block per line, 17 distinct points from 1..24 separated by spaces.

best_known.source: Covering Repository (coveringrepository.com), C(24,17,7) = 56 blocks: ours, listed since 2026-10-25 (before it 58); read 6 Nov 2026
